run.name: SM Energy Co
run.title: CP-OS host session (SM)
run.summary: SM Energy is financially sound and improving: net debt is USD 6,014 million, leverage is 1.42x, liquidity is USD 2,940 million and no note matures before mid-2028. It remains an oil-price story. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Senior Notes principal plus drawn revolver over FY2025 adjusted EBITDAX (non-GAAP, as reported); standalone SM Energy before the Merger.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. FY2025 adjusted EBITDAX over cash paid for interest, net of capitalized interest, for FY2025.

cash.basis: Cash. Commitments of 2,500 less letters of credit of 2; revolver undrawn. The borrowing base of 5.0 billion is not liquidity; commitments cap availability.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Trailing earnings mix the old and merged company, and covenant terms, ratings and legal documents are not supplied.
CP-1 main limitation: Trailing earnings include the acquired business only from 30 January 2026, and current covenant levels are not supplied.
